commit_message: Avoid private path literals in sanitizer fixtures
pr_title: GameEngine: add deterministic ADR visual scenarios
pr_body:
## Summary

Adds deterministic visual-validation scenarios for ADR 0136, 0137, 0138, 0139, 0144, 0149, and 0153. The fixtures are compiled only with the visual-validation feature and route through existing Editor graph canvas, Problems panel, Animation Preview, and AI Studio presentation paths. A dedicated Windows workflow captures one artifact directory per requested scenario.

Also preserves the existing Remote AI Studio sanitizer coverage while constructing synthetic Windows private-path fixtures at runtime so the public-snapshot static security scan does not misclassify deliberate test data as a leaked user path.
